title: Austin Housing: New Mortgage Bonds, Asset Sale
summary:
*   **Approved the creation and funding for new single-family mortgage bond programs** (Series A and B) through the Travis County Housing Finance Corporation, aimed at supporting homeownership.
*   **Authorized the sale of residual assets** from a prior 1991 Travis County residential mortgage bond program, concluding older financial arrangements.
